modification: Added CLONE_NEWUSER-filtered clone() and unshare() allow rules; clone() excludes s390/s390x. Kept the upstream clone3 ENOSYS rule without kernel/architecture narrowing so glibc always falls back to the filtered clone(). Added unconditional mount, umount2 and chroot allow rules because the mandatory --cap-drop ALL deployment drops capability-gated baseline rules; the namespace root is confined to Chromium's new user namespace.
